title: Information Security & SecOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to safeguard cloud environments and lead vulnerability assessments, SIEM monitoring, and incident response. You will collaborate with engineering teams to embed DevSecOps security best practices.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years in cloud security, vulnerability management, and threat detection.
- Hands-on experience with SIEM tools (Splunk/Elastic), penetration testing, and AWS security controls.
- Experience implementing compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST.
education_requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or Computer Science
